candidate_windows.window_text: We use the pre-trained model GPT-j (Wang and Komatsuzaki, 2021) as the base model for the embedding translation framework, and we used the deepspeed framework (Rasley et al., 2020) for distributed training on 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs. We finetune the GPT-j model for 3 epochs, with per_device_train_batch_size is 1 so that total batch_size is 8 and the learning rate is set to $1e - 5$ , warm-up_min_lr is $1e - 6$ and the maximum sequence length is set to 1560. We use the Adam optimizer with $\beta_{1} = 0.9$ and $\beta_{2} = 0.95$ . In addition, the weight Decay is set to 0.1, gradient Accumulation_steps is 4 and warm-up_ratio is 0.1.
